items.problem: Legacy Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs copied from UWP source causes CS0579 duplicate-attribute build failures in SDK-style WinUI projects.
items.evidence: session-log.txt ~4226-4234 'ProximitySensor.AssemblyInfo.cs(13,12): error CS0579: Duplicate System.Reflection.AssemblyCompanyAttribute'; hand-fixed at turns 63-65.
items.root_cause: SDK-style csproj auto-generates assembly attributes (GenerateAssemblyInfo defaults true); the copied UWP AssemblyInfo.cs duplicates them. Present in every UWP project and sub-project.
items.change: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: after the namespace rewrite, strip SDK-auto-generated assembly attribute lines (AssemblyTitle/Description/Configuration/Company/Product/Copyright/Trademark/Culture/Version/FileVersion/InformationalVersion) from every copied AssemblyInfo.cs, preserving ComVisible/InternalsVisibleTo/Guid. Added a backstop patterns entry documenting CS0579 + the GenerateAssemblyInfo=false alternative.
items.expected_effect: Migrations that copy any AssemblyInfo.cs no longer fail with CS0579; the agent never has to hand-diagnose it.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, dotnet build produces zero CS0579 errors and no manual AssemblyInfo edit turn appears in the log.

items.problem: When RootNamespace equals a WinRT type name, unqualified type use fails with CS0118 and a same-named using-alias fails with CS0576.
items.evidence: session-log.txt ~2850 'CS0118: ProximitySensor is a namespace but is used like a type'; ~3243 'CS0576 ...conflicting with alias ProximitySensor' after a same-named alias attempt (turn 44); resolved with distinct alias WdsSensor.
items.root_cause: Sensor/device SDK samples name the project after the feature; those names (ProximitySensor, Accelerometer, Gyrometer, Compass, ...) are types in Windows.Devices.Sensors, so RootNamespace shadows the type and a same-named alias collides.
items.change: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Common build errors after the namespace rewrite': new CS0118/CS0576 entry — reference the WinRT type via a DISTINCT alias or global::, never a same-named alias; lists the common shadowing sensor names.
items.expected_effect: Agent resolves the namespace-vs-type collision in one pass (distinct alias / global::) instead of a two-cycle same-named-alias recovery.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of a sample whose name matches a WinRT type, no CS0118 or CS0576 error survives to a second build cycle.
